reviewedTechnicalShape: contains=[] and type=atomic are labels, not semantic proof.

principles.objectChanged: Combination of whole maternal/paternal homologues from different chromosome types in a gamete.
principles.minimalRelevantModel: At least two different homologous pairs and two correct alternative orientation/segregation outcomes.
principles.separableEvidence: Learner explains that choosing a partner from one pair does not fix the partner from another pair and links different pair orientations to different gamete combinations.

principles.objectChanged: Combination of parental regions on participating chromatids within one homologous pair.
principles.minimalRelevantModel: One homologous pair with distinguishable parental regions, correct non-sister exchange and correct before/after chromatids.
principles.separableEvidence: Learner explains which corresponding regions exchanged and how this produces a recombinant participating chromatid without new/lost chromosome types or regions.

independenceCounterexamples.learnerPattern: Correctly explains alternative assortment from two pairs but says normal segment exchange occurs only between sister chromatids.
Correctly explains non-sister exchange in one homologous pair but says all maternal chromosomes must travel together to one gamete.

strongestKeepArgument: Both explanations share meiosis and the result of new combinations of existing information and could be shown in one assessment.
whyThatDoesNotEstablishAtomicity: Shared title, setting and outcome do not make one operation inferable from the other. Different changed objects, independent incorrect beliefs and separable mastery decisions remain. A single task can assess multiple goals.
ruleApplied: AGENTS.md section 7.1: an ordinary content leaf must contain exactly one content learning goal; judgment is semantic rather than keyword-based.

recommendation.children: Two separate proposed explanatory goals; IDs remain null.
recommendation.parent: An optional navigation cluster may hold the shared subject; it must not receive atomic content mastery.
recommendation.reasonNoAutomaticChildDependency: Whole-pair assortment is neither logically required for explaining segment exchange nor vice versa; shared model foundations should be supplied or separately bound.
recommendation.integratedComparison: A later integrated comparison goal would need its own independent semantic review and would not retroactively make this candidate atomic.
